newsitem.title: USA: NBC edges ahead of CBS in Nielsen ratings.
newsitem.headline: NBC edges ahead of CBS in Nielsen ratings.

text.p: General Electric Co unit NBC attracted the largest prime-time evening audience during the week of June 30 to July 6, Nielsen Media Research said Tuesday.
Right on NBC's heals was Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS, which placed second. Walt Disney Co came in third in the number of homes tuned to evening-hours programs.
In fourth place was Fox Network, owned by News Corp Ltd.
-- NBC drew an average 6.6 rating, or percentage of America's roughly 97 million homes with television, and a 14 percent share of homes watching television during evening hours;
-- CBS won a 6.5 rating on average, and a 13 percent share of homes watching television;
-- ABC's average rating was 5.6 for the week and its share was 12 percent;
-- FOX had a 4.2 average rating and a share percentage of 9 percent;
-- WB, a unit of Time Warner Inc, had a 2.3 rating and a five percent share.
